answer: Identity bonds that decay stop sybils parking cheap fakes. Each agent posts a 60 POA bond that decays 5% per epoch unless honest work refreshes it; the decayed part burns. Each epoch the network takes the pulse of each bond, checking fresh attestations. Like yarrow, it thrives only with steady care. 1,000 fakes cost 3,000 POA per epoch plus 60,000 locked; one honest agent pays 3 POA and keeps its full share — a velvet rope pricing idleness out.
